name: Defense S&T Key Laboratory of Lightweight, High-strength Structural Materials at Central South University
zh: 轻质高强结构材料国防科技重点实验室
zhAliases: 轻质高强结构材料国家级重点实验室
aliases: State Key Laboratory for Light Weight and High Strength Structural Materials
National Key Laboratory of Science and Technology for National Defence on High-strength Lightweight Structural Materials
supervisors: Central South University (host; its Powder Metallurgy Research Institute)

evidence.summary: CASI identifies it as the national defence science and technology key laboratory for lightweight, high-strength structural materials, set up in 2005 under Central South University’s Powder Metallurgy Research Institute, which researches lightweight structural materials for aviation and aerospace; the institute’s lightweight alloys are used in aviation, aerospace, weapons, shipbuilding and the nuclear industry.
items: Defense S&T Key Laboratory of Lightweight, High-strength Structural Materials (轻质高强结构材料国防科技重点实验室)

evidence.summary: CASI reports that from 2013 to 2019 the laboratory co-hosted a high-level forum on aerospace engineering and high-performance materials, often with CASC’s China Academy of Space Technology and its 703rd Research Institute among the co-hosts.

sources.title: China’s Defense S&T Key Lab System: 2025 Update (October 2025), pp. 286–288 (Defense S&T Key Laboratory of Lightweight, High-strength Structural Materials)
